  "summary": "The requirement SFMC-REQ-038 specifies a performance criterion for the SFMC software to update flight information displayed to the pilot at a minimum rate of 10 times per second during normal operation. This is a clear, specific, and measurable performance requirement consistent with the SRS section 5 Performance Requirements, which includes similar timing and responsiveness requirements (e.g., SFMC-REQ-037). The requirement is well-written, unambiguous, and verifiable. There is no explicit software allocation detail in the SRS for this update frequency, but it is implied as a software responsibility given the SFMC's role in displaying flight information (Section 2.1 Pilot Interface). No undefined terms or vague criteria are present. No direct linkage to the specified SWE requirements (SWE-050, SWE-051, SWE-184, SWE-053, SWE-054, SWE-055) is supported by the supplied NPR passages. The requirement aligns with NASA-HDBK-2203-5.09 guidance on clear, measurable software requirements (§3 Guidance)."
